mapper.insert:
insert into `dispatch_group`(id,parent_id,code,name,type,valid_time,sort, tenant,deleted,create_by,create_time,update_by,update_time) values
(#{item.id},#{item.parentId},#{item.code},#{item.name},#{item.type},#{item.validTime},#{item.sort}, #{item.tenant},#{item.deleted},#{item.createBy},#{item.createTime},#{item.updateBy},#{item.updateTime})
on duplicate key update name = values(name), sort = values(sort), parent_id = values(parent_id), valid_time = values(valid_time), update_time = values(update_time)
mapper.select:
select * from (select g.id,g.parent_id,g.code,g.name,g.type,'group' as category,g.tenant,g.deleted from dispatch_group g union all select d.id,r.group_id,d.code,d.name,d.type,'device' as category,d.tenant,d.deleted from dispatch_device d left join dispatch_device_group_refer r on d.id = r.device_id) t
t.tenant = #{param.tenant} and t.deleted = 0
and (t.name like concat('%',#{param.keyword},'%') or t.code like concat('%',#{param.keyword},'%'))
and t.type = #{param.type}

select g.id,g.parent_id,g.code,g.name,g.type,'group' as category,1 as status,g.tenant,g.deleted from dispatch_group g
g.tenant = #{param.tenant} and g.deleted = 0
and (g.type = #{param.type} or g.parent_id = '' or g.parent_id = null)
union all select d.id,r.group_id as parent_id,d.code,d.name,d.type,'device' as category,s.online_status as status,d.tenant,d.deleted from dispatch_device d left join dispatch_device_group_refer r on d.id = r.device_id left join dispatch_device_status s on d.id = s.id
d.tenant = #{param.tenant} and d.deleted = 0 and r.group_id is not null
and (d.name like concat('%',#{param.keyword},'%') or d.code like concat('%',#{param.keyword},'%'))
and d.type = #{param.deviceType}
and s.online_status = #{param.deviceOnline}
